CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2851 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head e666f058175780b75b2a6bdbe1ada7e80f369225. Bus nonce: e9a1c5fc6bc76b211c01d01b6a462878. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin e666f058175780b75b2a6bdbe1ada7e80f369225`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge e666f058175780b75b2a6bdbe1ada7e80f369225` or `Fix review: blocked e666f058175780b75b2a6bdbe1ada7e80f369225 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: e9a1c5fc6bc76b211c01d01b6a462878`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `e666f058175780b75b2a6bdbe1ada7e80f369225` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2851 e666f058175780b75b2a6bdbe1ada7e80f369225") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2851-e9a1c5fc`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
FULL REVIEW (record-shaped) of #2851 (roster batch 18), head e666f058175780b75b2a6bdbe1ada7e80f369225, bus nonce e9a1c5fc6bc76b211c01d01b6a462878, against dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md (origin/main) from a detached worktree at the head SHA. The pull request changes dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json and its delivery row dev/programme/delivery/2851.md only. Its nine roster ops (roster queue lines 372-380; handoff 78d071da8, main merge 908788012 and the row commit e666f058175780b75b2a6bdbe1ada7e80f369225 on top): 466c345df set-stage R10-PROOF-CODEQL done; 5d17ebe7d, 492882021, 82dda60af and 789feaaa7 append-carry R10-TRAIN-OVERLAP-GRADE (triage P184, P189, P191, P189 round 2); b416158d0 and 42cc77736 append-carry R10-FLOW-DESIGN-STAGES (P185, P187); 35be2daa9 append-carry R10-ORCH-BEATD (P190); 78d071da8 append-group R10-RCA-RATELIMIT-RECUR (the root-cause group for triage P192/V112, the 04:53Z installation rate-limit burst that reddened #2850 and #2843). Check:
- every op cites a merged ruling or merged PR (commit message, op note, or the carry text's triage reference); name any that cites neither. For set-stage R10-PROOF-CODEQL done: verify its PR merged (git merge-base --is-ancestor <merge commit> origin/main), reading the ref, not the record.
- each appended carry is verbatim from the carry file the roster seat used (triage-carries/b32-P184.txt, b32-P185, b32-P187, b32-P189, b32-P189-r2, b32-P190, b32-P191 in the orchestrator's directory, which may not be readable to you: if so say UNVERIFIED for verbatim and instead check the carry text against its triage reference in dev/programme/triage/ at the head or origin/main, and that no two carries repeat), that no carry was dropped without re-routing (python3 -I tools/audit/carry_audit.py pr 2851: 0 unrouted), and that each carry sits on the group the ruling names.
- the appended group R10-RCA-RATELIMIT-RECUR is well-formed: JSON matches the schema the roster lint enforces (run it), has topic r10-rca-ratelimit-recur, does not duplicate an existing group id, and its carry cites P192. The group count rises by exactly 1: count the groups at origin/main and at the head and print both.
- the delivery row dev/programme/delivery/2851.md is in the three-dot diff (git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...HEAD), and the diff touches nothing else: VERSION, manifest, RELEASE_NOTES and both claim files untouched.
- node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs on the merged tree prints 0 errors; run it. git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD exits 0.
Read CI on this head from the check-runs API and name every red (governance / delivery-status is not required; a red on the installation rate limit, HTTP 403 or RATE-LIMITED, died before any test body and is infra: say so, do not call it a finding). Re-read refs/pull/2851/head with git ls-remote before writing.
Output: write verdict.md in a fresh directory of your own. First line exactly "Fix review: merge e666f058175780b75b2a6bdbe1ada7e80f369225" or "Fix review: blocked e666f058175780b75b2a6bdbe1ada7e80f369225 <class>: <reason>" (no brackets; class lower-case letters and dashes). Then a blank line, then "bus-nonce: e9a1c5fc6bc76b211c01d01b6a462878". Then sections: a blocked verdict's block under "## Block"; each finding this PR does not settle is its own bullet under "## Findings" ending in "Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>"; the rest under "## Evidence" with files under ev/, one holding the full 40-hex head. Return it on a probe ref: the commit is built with a private index as the role file gives, then pushed to refs/heads/probe/rev-2851-e9a1c5fc. Do NOT run bus.sh.
